content:
The Laredo Police Department is renewing its call for the public's help in the unsolved murder of James “Jimmy” Ellis, whose case remains active and ongoing.

The incident happened in the area of 200 Cortez. During the investigation, detectives identified a person of interest who was seen leaving the area of Mr. Ellis’ home wearing a distinctive green shirt.

Despite earlier public awareness efforts, no arrests have been made. Police say the case has not been forgotten, and investigators remain committed to following up on any new leads — including anonymous tips — that could help bring those responsible to justice.

Police are asking the public to take a moment to review the photos and video previously released in the case. Someone may recognize the person in the images or have information that could prove crucial.

Anyone with information can contact the Laredo Police Department anonymously at 956-795-2800 or give an anonymous tip to Laredo Crime Stoppers at 727-TIPS.

Source: Laredo Police Department, Facebook, November 9, 2026.
